access_links.label: DOI Nature-based Solutions Roadmap on the U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit

description: DOI Nature-based Solutions Roadmap is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by DOI, U.S. Department of the Interior. This tool provides Department of Interior (DOI) staff with consistent and credible information about nature-based solutions, such as which strategies match certain conditions and goals, what co-benefits they are likely to provide, example projects, and additional resources for project planning, construction, and monitoring. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Flooding – Coastal, Landslides, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Urban Landscape and Tree Canopy, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
